_comment: Per-route page metadata: the single source for both consumers.
scripts/prerender.mjs reads it from Node and bakes the tags into dist/<path>/index.html,
because social and chat unfurlers (Slack, LINE, Twitter, Facebook) do not run JavaScript;
src/seo/useSeo.ts reads the same file at runtime for the title Google's rendered pass and
GA's page_title see. It lives here as JSON rather than in i18n/index.ts because the
prerender step has to read it without a TypeScript build. Bilingual all the same:
prerender emits `zh` to match <html lang="zh-Hant">, the hook follows the active language.
Only indexable routes belong here. /explore, /record/:id, /dashboard and /login are
excluded from crawling in public/robots.txt and get no entry.
Optional `card.title` overrides the headline on the OG image only (scripts/og-image.mjs),
for titles that are too long to set at card size. The page's real <title> is unaffected.

title.zh: TBIA自然史標本探索與標註平台

description.en: A collaborative platform for enriching TBIA natural-history specimen records. Find occurrences missing identification, coordinates or dates, fill them by hand or with AI-assisted label transcription, and return reviewed enrichments to data providers.
description.zh: TBIA 自然史標本資料的協作標註平台。找出缺少鑑定、座標或日期的標本紀錄，以人工或 AI 輔助的標籤辨識補齊，並將審核後的補遺回饋給資料提供者。

card.title: 填補標本後設資料的缺口

schema.name: TBIA 自然史標本探索與標註平台
schema.description: 台灣生物多樣性資訊聯盟（TBIA）自然史標本紀錄的協作補遺平台，涵蓋 945 個資料集、約 208 萬筆標本紀錄。

creator.name: TBIA 台灣生物多樣性資訊聯盟

description.en: Every distinct scientific name in the store — 44,874 of them, 33,810 identified to species rank or below — searchable and sortable, each linking to the records that carry it. Names are listed as the store holds them, reconciled against no checklist.
description.zh: 資料庫中的每一個學名——共 44,874 個，其中 33,810 個鑑定到種級以下——可搜尋、可排序，並可連至使用該學名的標本紀錄。學名照資料庫原樣列出，未與任何名錄比對。

description.en: The institutions and aggregators behind the specimen records — their datasets, record counts, and a way into the records themselves.
description.zh: 標本紀錄背後的典藏機構與整合平台——各自的資料集、紀錄數量，以及進入紀錄本身的入口。

description.en: The people behind the specimens: searchable collector profiles with what each one collected, when, where, and how much of it still needs georeferencing.
description.zh: 標本背後的採集者：可搜尋的採集者列表，呈現每個人採了什麼、何時、何地，以及還有多少紀錄需要定位。

description.en: Ranked by annotations a reviewer accepted — the work that actually reached a data provider.
description.zh: 依審核通過的註記數排名——也就是真正回饋給資料提供者的成果。

description.en: Topics that read the collection as a narrative rather than a result set: who went where, when, and what of it can still be found in the store today. Each topic works from a published source and queries the specimen data live.
description.zh: 以敘事的方式閱讀典藏，而不只是查詢結果：誰在何時去了哪裡，以及今天在資料庫裡還找得到什麼。每則故事都以已出版的文獻為本，並即時查詢標本資料。

title.en: A history of botanical survey in Taiwan

description.en: The expeditions that built Taiwan's plant collections, 1854–1988 — a 37-entry chronology transcribed from published literature, with each entry's collectors linked to the records they left behind.
description.zh: 1854 至 1988 年間建立台灣植物典藏的歷次調查——轉錄自已出版文獻的 37 則年表記事，並將每則記事的採集者連到他們留下的標本紀錄。

schema.name: 台灣植物調查研究史年表
schema.description: 附錄一：台灣植物調查研究史年表，37 則記事，1854–1988。轉錄自已出版文獻，並將記事中的採集者連結至標本紀錄。
citation: 許建昌 (1975) 附錄一：台灣植物調查研究史年表。

title.en: Dr. Ching-I Peng | Begonias of the World
title.zh: 彭鏡毅博士｜世界秋海棠

description.en: Twenty years of fieldwork on Begonia across Asia, Europe and beyond — transcribed from a digital curation, with every trip answered by the specimens Peng collected in those exact days.
description.zh: 橫跨亞洲、歐洲等地二十餘年的秋海棠田野調查——轉錄自數位策展，每一趟行程都以彭老師在那幾天實際採集的標本回答。

schema.name: 彭鏡毅博士｜世界秋海棠
schema.description: 彭鏡毅博士二十餘年的秋海棠採集行程與發表物種，轉錄自中央研究院生物多樣性研究博物館（BRMAS）的數位策展。
schema.citation: 中央研究院生物多樣性研究博物館（BRMAS）數位策展。

description.en: How to find a record with a metadata gap, propose a correction, and how review works before an enrichment reaches a data provider.
description.zh: 如何找出後設資料有缺口的標本紀錄、提出補正，以及補遺回饋給資料提供者之前的審核流程。

description.en: A worked example of AI-assisted label transcription: one herbarium sheet from finding it, through reading its label, to checking what the model proposed and sending it for review.
description.zh: AI 輔助標籤辨識的實做示範：以一份臘葉標本為例，從找到它、讀它的標籤，到檢查 AI 提出的建議值並送出審核。
